snippet.title: Twisted Tower - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Step right up to Twisted Tower; an abandoned 1950s resort where fairy-tale mascots have gone bad, carnival rides need more than a little maintenance, and reaching the top may be the only way to save the love of your life.

Explore hauntingly beautiful locations, from a mysterious hotel and sprawling waterpark to a clown casino, and more! Blast your way through corrupted fairy-tale mascots with an arsenal of wonderfully bizarre weapons, uncover the secrets of your past, and choose your path through a world that changes with every playthrough.

Jump, dash, and grapple your way upward using bizarre toys, upgrade your arsenal, and discover what awaits at the top of the Twisted Tower.

Twisted Tower is available NOW on PC via Steam. 

🎮 Get Twisted Tower: https://bit.ly/3U2C83v
